features.text: Cushioned rocker bottom sole promotes smoother walking motion during cast wear
Durable canvas upper construction provides lasting protection throughout recovery
Open toe design accommodates various cast sizes and reduces pressure points
Adjustable hook-and-loop straps at heel and forefoot ensure secure positioning
Available in seven sizes to accommodate different cast dimensions

measurement: Refer to our sizing chart for proper measurements, or visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for personalized fitting assistance from our medical team. Consider cast dimensions when selecting your size.
